postings.title: Senior Principal Radar Systems Engineer
top_requirements: Design and develop radar front‑end RF circuits, including low‑noise amplifiers and mixers, for low‑Earth‑orbit satellite platforms.
Perform end‑to‑end link‑budget analysis and RF system simulations to meet target detection range and resolution specifications.
Lead hardware bring‑up, test, and validation of radar subsystems in thermal‑vacuum and RF anechoic chambers.
postings.summary: The role focuses on creating high‑performance radar hardware for a LEO satellite constellation, leveraging deep RF and signal‑processing expertise. It aligns with the candidate’s background in satellite communications and hands‑on RF system design.

postings.title: Systems Algorithm Engineer
top_requirements: Design custom silicon blocks for high‑speed data converters and RF front‑ends, including layout, simulation, and silicon validation.
Develop and optimize signal‑processing algorithms (e.g., OFDM modem, channel estimation) that run on the custom ASIC and interface with sensor data.
Perform full stack bring‑up from silicon characterization to firmware integration and system‑level testing on robotic platforms.
postings.summary: Lyte AI seeks a hands‑on engineer to create mixed‑signal ASICs for perception systems, a perfect fit for the candidate’s modem design and signal‑processing background while moving into a non‑aerospace environment.

postings.title: Hiring for Electrical Engineer - Signal Processing & Analog Circuits | Cupertino, CA - Onsite || FTE
top_requirements: Design and prototype analog front‑end circuits for high‑frequency signal conditioning, including filters, amplifiers, and mixers.
Implement and validate digital signal‑processing algorithms on FPGA or DSP hardware for real‑time data conversion.
Perform comprehensive network analysis and S‑parameter measurements to verify circuit performance against specifications.
postings.summary: The role combines analog circuit design with signal‑processing implementation, directly leveraging the candidate’s expertise in RF and modem hardware.

postings.title: Assistant/Principal Engineer (FPGA)
top_requirements: Translate system‑level communication requirements into detailed FPGA architecture and RTL specifications.
Develop and verify high‑speed serial interfaces (e.g., JESD204B, LVDS) for RF front‑end data acquisition.
Perform timing analysis, floorplanning, and hardware bring‑up to ensure FPGA designs meet stringent latency and jitter constraints.
postings.summary: The FPGA engineering role involves hands‑on hardware design for communications and radar systems, leveraging the candidate’s RF and digital design background.

postings.title: Satellite Systems Engineer - RF & Communications
top_requirements: Configure and test satellite RF front‑end hardware, including spectrum analysis, link‑budget verification, and antenna alignment.
Develop Linux‑based automation scripts (Docker, Ansible) for multi‑server deployment of signal‑processing pipelines.
Perform end‑to‑end system validation, troubleshooting RF path losses, and ensuring compliance with satellite communication standards.
postings.summary: A hands‑on RF and communications engineering position at Rohde & Schwarz that matches the candidate’s satellite communications and RF testing experience while moving toward broader telecom applications.
